name: epoch
description: Epoch workspace for core SDK, CLI, and WASM hosts.

scripts.agents:install-skills: npx --yes skills@1.5.23 add dmmulroy/anti-slop --skill install-anti-slop --agent claude-code --agent cursor --agent codex --agent grok -y --copy
scripts.gate:commit: npm run gate:fast && npm run community-web:app:a11y-lint && npm run community-web:app:design-lint
scripts.gate:push: npm run gate:commit && npm run typecheck && npm run build -- --pretty false && npm run test:unit:runtime
scripts.features: npm run build -- --pretty false && npm run test:features:runtime
scripts.change-graph:packages: npm test -w @epoch/protocol && npm test -w @epoch/forge && npm test -w @epoch/software-heritage && npm test -w @epoch/openzl && npm test -w @epoch/nats && npm test -w @epoch/xmpp && npm run build -w @epoch/identity-bridge && node --test packages/Epoch.Identity.Bridge/test/*.test.mjs
scripts.change-graph:conformance: npm run build -- --pretty false && node dist/test/conformance/change-graph-convergence.property.test.js && node dist/test/security/change-graph-security.test.js && node dist/test/compatibility/change-graph-compatibility.test.js
scripts.fuzz:fast-check: npm run build -- --pretty false && node dist/test/fuzz/properties/parser-roundtrip.fast-check.test.js && node dist/test/fuzz/properties/fabric-auth.fast-check.test.js && node dist/test/fuzz/properties/service-discovery.fast-check.test.js && node dist/test/fuzz/properties/live-spaces.fast-check.test.js && node dist/test/fuzz/properties/session-init-probe.fast-check.test.js && EPOCH_FUZZ_RUNS=${EPOCH_FUZZ_RUNS:-48} node dist/test/fuzz/history/history.fast-check.test.js
scripts.fuzz:history:long: npm run build -- --pretty false && EPOCH_FUZZ_HISTORY_LONG=1 EPOCH_FUZZ_RUNS=${EPOCH_FUZZ_RUNS:-400} node dist/test/fuzz/history/history.fast-check.test.js
scripts.fuzz:regression: npm run build -- --pretty false && node dist/test/fuzz/regressions/corpus-regression.test.js && node dist/test/fuzz/regressions/jazzer-swhid-forge-malformed.test.js
scripts.test:unit:community-web-app-parity: npm run build -w @epoch/community-core && npm run build -w @epoch/community-api && tsgo -p tsconfig.test.json && node dist/test/run-community-web-app-parity-tests.js
scripts.test:pact:consumer: npm run build -- --pretty false && node dist/test/pact/run-pact-consumer.js
scripts.test:pact:provider: npm run build -- --pretty false && node dist/test/pact/run-pact-provider.js
scripts.test:pact: npm run build -- --pretty false && node dist/test/pact/run-pact-tests.js

scripts.coverage: npm run build -- --pretty false && c8 npm run test:runtime
scripts.test: npm run build -- --pretty false && npm run test:runtime
scripts.verify: npm run docs:check && npm run lint && npm run community-web:app:a11y-lint && npm run community-web:app:design-lint && npm run design:lint && npm run design:audit && npm run typecheck && npm run konsistent && npm test && npm run change-graph:schemas:check && npm run community-web:app:build:check && npm run a11y:community-web && npm run community-web:app:a11y && npm run coverage && npm run test:pact && npm run community-web:app:parity && npm run community-web:app:faults && npm run community-web:app:e2e
scripts.community-web:app:parity: npm run community-web:app:build:check && npm run test:unit:community-web-app-parity && node packages/Epoch.Community.Web/test/navigation-projection.test.mjs && node packages/Epoch.Community.Web/test/cli-tools-pass.test.mjs && node packages/Epoch.Community.Web/test/nats-fabric.test.mjs && node scripts/verify-community-web-app-parity.mjs && CW_E2E=NAV- node packages/Epoch.Community.Web/test/e2e.mjs
